sources.headline: Rams WR Puka Nacua likely to be placed on injured reserve with turf toe, sprained MCL and PCL
sources.description: Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua is likely to be placed on injured reserve after suffering a turf toe injury and spraining his MCL and PCL in Sunday's 20-13 win over the Commanders, head coach Sean McVay said Monday.

sources.headline: Rams Expected To Place Puka Nacua On IR With MCL, PCL Sprains And Turf Toe
sources.description: Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua tore his ACL on the Rams’ final offensive snap of Sunday’s 20-13 win over the Washington Commanders, after an MRI on Monday confirmed the injury.
